issue_request: FHIR-13512 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 CDS change request asking that RequestGroup.reasonCodeableConcept and RequestGroup.reasonReference be moved out to top-level reasonCode and reasonReference fields, consistent with the then-current Request pattern.
initial_application: The Jira comment records SVN 12255, and converted git commit 571fea972c605378a443f9fa8c2bace66e61a178 applied that work by changing RequestGroup.reason[x] into top-level RequestGroup.reasonCode and RequestGroup.reasonReference in the spreadsheet and example.
additional_context: FHIR-24619 later renamed RequestGroup to RequestOrchestration. The active fhir.ini resource is requestorchestration=RequestOrchestration, with RequestGroup mapped to RequestOrchestration for R4-to-R6 migration. Current Request pattern source uses Request.reason as a top-level CodeableReference, with Request.reasonReference retained only as a migration row.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current RequestOrchestration has exactly one top-level reason element, RequestOrchestration.reason, typed as CodeableReference and mapped to Request.reason; there is no nested action reason or legacy reasonCodeableConcept/reasonReference definition to fix.
